This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice and should not replace the guidance of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services (911) immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. While using this medication, laboratory and/or medical tests, such as a complete blood count or liver function tests, should be conducted as recommended by your healthcare provider. Ensure that you attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. If you miss a dose of the medication, consult your doctor or pharmacist promptly to establish a new dosing schedule. Store the medication in a refrigerator and do not freeze it. Keep the medication in its original container to protect it from light. Certain brands of this medication may also be stored at room temperature if necessary. Consult your pharmacist or the product packaging to determine if your medication can be stored at room temperature and for how long. Discard any unused portion of the medication. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly dispose of this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Your medical condition may lead to complications in the event of a medical emergency. Ensure that your healthcare providers are aware of your condition.
